title.en: les puces du canal, sunday morning.
title.tr: les puces du canal'da pazar sabahı.

line.en: the permanent flea market in villeurbanne is open on sundays. go early, bring cash and a tote bag.
line.de: der dauerhafte flohmarkt in villeurbanne hat sonntags geöffnet. früh hingehen, bargeld und eine tasche mitnehmen.
line.tr: villeurbanne'daki sürekli pazar pazar günleri açık. erken gidin, nakit ve bir çanta alın.

sparks.why: Les Puces du Canal, Villeurbanne, permanent market open thursdays, saturdays and sundays; sundays 07:00 to 15:00 per auvergnerhonealpes-tourisme.com and a market directory (both agree). The big international déballage is on 26 Nov, not this day.
